cues.text: Let's apply this to the submitted UniSteel predictive-maintenance case.
In the Nigerian manufacturing plant, welding lines have temperature and vibration sensors, programmable logic controllers and SCADA.
A flat Ethernet network makes broadcast traffic and fault isolation difficult.
Segment production cells into operational technology VLANs and use controlled routing gateways.
Place redundant edge nodes near the line or distribution networks, inside a secure OT zone.
Collect approved read-only telemetry.
Keep PLC safety control independent of the WAN and predictive model decisions.

Local anomaly detection validates and timestamps readings, extracts rolling features, estimates anomalies, suppresses flapping, deduplicates events using stable identifiers and alerts SCADA or a supervisor.
During WAN loss, queue alerts durably.
An industrial demilitarised-zone relay sends authorised outbound events to the cloud.
Never expose the PLCs directly to the Internet.
Here is the bandwidth calculation, which is an illustration, not a measured plant result.
One hundred sensors, multiplied by ten readings per second, multiplied by one hundred bytes per reading, gives one hundred thousand bytes per second.
Multiply by eight for bits: zero point eight megabits per second.
Across a day, that is eight point six four gigabytes of raw data.
Suppose alerts and required metadata average zero point one two megabits per second.
Subtract zero point one two from zero point eight, divide by zero point eight and multiply by one hundred.
The result is eighty-five percent reduction, exceeding the sixty percent target under those assumptions.
For a reduction greater than sixty percent, cloud-bound traffic must be below forty percent of the original rate, here strictly below zero point three two megabits per second.
Actual calculation needs measured alert frequency, event size, retries, protocol overhead and peaks.
Local storage is separate from WAN transfer.
Seven days of raw data would be about sixty point four eight gigabytes before indexes or replication.
Retain summaries and incident records according to justified policy, not invented deployment evidence.
For security, use least privilege, segmentation, firewalls, authenticated devices, TLS, protected keys, encryption of local storage, signed updates, physical protection, audit and monitoring.
Nigeria's Data Protection Act applies to personal data within scope; equipment telemetry may not be personal unless it can be linked to staff.
Minimise identifying data and define retention and lawful access.
For resilience, provide redundant edge nodes, uninterruptible power, a durable queue, fallback local alarms, tested restore, deduplication and reconciliation, and a degraded operating mode.
Models produce false positives and false negatives and can drift; include human confirmation.
Predictive inference must not be the sole safety interlock.
